feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Reporting on the money that flows through our economy, from Wall Street financial firms to Silicon Valley tech giants, small businesses, consumers, employers and workers. Plus podcast episodes of Planet Money and The Indicator.

entry.title: Jensen Huang biographer reacts to the Nvidia CEO's resignation
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with Stephen Witt, author of a Jensen Huang biography, about his resignation from his role as CEO of Nvidia.

entry.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang steps down amid alleged spy scandal
entry.summary: Huang co-founded the chipmaker Nvidia, which has become one of the driving forces behind the AI boom. But reports that he may have had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy quickly sank his career.

entry.title: Why is gasoline suddenly under $4 a gallon?
entry.summary: The average price of a gallon of gasoline dipped below $4 this week for the first time in months. Does that mean more relief is coming for drivers?

entry.title: Oil giant ExxonMobil left Venezuela years ago. Now it's considering a return
entry.summary: ExxonMobil has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Venezuelan government and its state-owned oil company to explore opportunities in the country.

entry.title: The scandal surrounding the head of Nvidia could have wide-ranging implications
entry.summary: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer speaks with Bloomberg tech reporter Ian King about the unusually overarching role of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at his company and within the American tech industry at large.

entry.title: Should you trust new AI agents with your money and data?
entry.summary: Tech companies want agentic AI to be the new way you shop. But should you trust AI when your money's involved?

entry.title: Americans across the economic spectrum feel a 'panic' about finances, author says
entry.summary: Mona Chalabi spent five years following Americans living paycheck to paycheck, as well as those earning top wages. Her new book, Ten Lives, explores why financial security can feel so elusive.

entry.title: Gas prices dip below $4 but inflation remains stubbornly high
entry.summary: Gasoline prices fell below $4 a gallon Tuesday for the first time in three months — but the overall cost of living remains stubbornly high.

entry.title: The average cost for a new vehicle in the U.S. hits a record high: over $51,000
entry.summary: Vehicle transaction prices are up to a new record high, according to the Kelley Blue Book — and some buyers are extending their car loans to finance them.

entry.title: Why did California's billionaire tax fail to surf the blue wave?
entry.summary: Two economists debate what California's vote on Prop 40 means for the wealth tax movement.
